headline: Pixel 11 specs and price leak with no surprises
summary: Android Headlines leaked Pixel 11 specs and pricing. The details align with previous rumors. The Pixel 11 is expected to start at $899 with a $100 price hike.

headline: Angela Nissel faces down grief with a laugh
summary: Angela Nissel's new memoir, 'Good Grief, Pass the Bread, Mom Is Dead,' explores caring for a terminally ill parent. The book offers a deeply emotional narrative. It's delivered with gallows humor to cope with tough times.

headline: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
summary: Fenix Flexin's track 'Rubberz' reached number 58 on the Billboard Hot 100. Questions quickly arose about the song's origins. Many speculate the song was largely AI-generated.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leak racks up millions of views
summary: A bootleg of Spider-Man: Brand New Day was available on X for over seven hours. It reached more than 5.9 million accounts. Disney is now actively pulling down reposts.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Beats Avengers: Endgame Record to Claim Biggest Domestic Opening Day of All Time
summary: Marvel Studios' Spider-Man: Brand New Day set a new domestic box office record. It earned a whopping $168 million on its opening day. This surpasses the previous record held by Avengers: Endgame.

headline: Game of Thrones: The Mad King Reveals Full Stage Cast and First Portrait
summary: The full stage cast for 'Game of Thrones: The Mad King' has been revealed. See the first official cast photo. It features King Aerys II, Rhaegar Targaryen, and Young Ned Stark.

headline: Vincent Pastore, The Sopranos Actor, Dies at 80
summary: Vincent Pastore, actor from The Sopranos, has passed away. He was best known for playing Salvatore Bonpensiero. Pastore was 80 years old.

headline: Elden Ring Players Are Hoping for Godwyn DLC After FromSoftware Shares Cryptic Social Media Post
summary: Elden Ring fans are speculating about new Godwyn-themed DLC. FromSoftware shared a cryptic social media post. This comes two years after the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion.

headline: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
summary: Trump claims he canceled Iran strikes after a request from Iran and other Middle Eastern countries. He stated the 'perimeters' of a deal had been agreed upon. This decision hinged on a rapid resolution.

headline: The shadowy gang recruiting teenage hitmen to kill across Europe
summary: The Foxtrot Network is recruiting teenage hitmen across Europe. The gang is believed responsible for approximately 35 murders. They employ a 'violence-as-a-service' model.

headline: Body of mountaineer Nirmal Purja recovered after Pakistan avalanche
summary: The body of renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja was recovered. This follows an avalanche in Pakistan. Purja was famous for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months.

headline: Five dead, 41 missing, after Indonesia ferry catches fire
summary: A ferry carrying at least 250 people caught fire off Madura island, Indonesia. Five fatalities have been confirmed. At least 41 passengers remain missing.
